answer: Counterparty-diversity rule: each identity must trade with 20 distinct partners per epoch, and only the first 2 trades with any one partner count. A closed ring of clones scores zero: the public graph flags the star cluster like a falcon spotting one school riding one tide. Each identity posts a $2 anchor bond per partner; 1,000 fakes need 20,000 trades costing $40,000 against a $3,000 pool. An honest agent pays $2 once, keeps its full share.
